claims.statement: Memphis, near modern Mit Rahina, was a capital during the Early Dynastic Period and Old Kingdom.
The city was an important centre for the worship of Ptah.
UNESCO Site of Memphis reference. This locates the existing editorial study window; it does not establish continuous occupation, temple activity or a city boundary.

evidence.note: Editorial browsing window 3100 BCE–200 CE, not the city’s complete lifespan. The traditional foundation story is not treated as a precisely dated event. A city-specific map position remains to be checked.
